name: Asian Pork Rice Noodle Soup with Carrot, Mushroom, Spinach & Fresh Herbs (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb cremini mushrooms
¼ small bunch cilantro
¼ small bunch green onion (scallion)
½ lime
1 orange
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, carrot, pork, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 lb lean ground pork
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the reserved bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the cilantro.
Juice lime into the bowl, then add fish sauce and chili-garlic sauce. Stir to combine and set aside for the adults.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp fish sauce
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, add broth and soy sauce to the pot, stir to combine, and bring soup to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, halve orange lengthwise, then cut each half into 1-inch thick wedges. Set aside for the kid's plates.
Once the soup is boiling, reduce heat to medium. Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.

FOR THE KIDS: Cut 1 cup of noodles into bite-size pieces and divide between bowls. Add 1 cup of soup to each bowl, making sure to get some of everything! Serve with orange wedges on the side. 

FOR THE ADULTS: Divide remaining noodles and soup between bowls. Top with herb sauce and enjoy!
